name: EU REACH
full_name: EU REACH — Restricted Substances in Textiles (SVHC)

rules.requirement: Azo dyes that can release carcinogenic aromatic amines are prohibited in textile articles. Formaldehyde must not exceed 75 ppm for infant articles and 300 ppm for skin-contact garments.
rules.recommendation: Commission an Oeko-Tex or SGS chemical compliance test for all dye lots from current suppliers.

rules.requirement: Lead content in textile dyes must not exceed 50 ppm per OEKO-TEX Standard 100 and EU REACH Annex XVII restrictions. Chromium VI must stay below 3 mg/kg.
rules.source_section: REACH Annex XVII Entry 63 (lead) / Entry 47 (Cr VI)
rules.recommendation: Switch to REACH-compliant dye suppliers and commission an SGS or Intertek full SVHC panel test.

rules.requirement: Nonylphenol ethoxylates (NPEs) are restricted in textile articles, and effluent discharge must stay within environmental limits (8 ppm reference ceiling).
rules.recommendation: Adjust the effluent-treatment plant and re-sample before the next OEKO-TEX surveillance audit.
